--create new refrence type for rule status declare @referenceTypeIdStatus int = (SELECT ID FROM [ReferenceItemType] WHERE [Name] ='Rule Status')
if @referenceTypeIdStatus > 0 update [ReferenceItemType] set [Name] = 'Rule Status #2' where ID = @referenceTypeIdStatus
INSERT INTO [dbo].[ReferenceItemType] ([Name],[DisplayFormat],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy]) VALUES ('Rule Status', '{Name}', GETDATE(), 0)
--popuplate Rule status reference list set @referenceTypeIdStatus = (SELECT ID FROM [ReferenceItemType] WHERE [Name] ='Rule Status') INSERT INTO [dbo].[ReferenceItem] ([ReferenceItemTypeID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[Code],[Visible]) VALUES (@referenceTypeIdStatus,GETDATE(),0,'Inactive',1), (@referenceTypeIdStatus,GETDATE(),0,'Draft',1), (@referenceTypeIdStatus,GETDATE(),0,'Active',1)
--create new refrence type for rule dimension declare @referenceTypeIdDimension int = (SELECT ID FROM [ReferenceItemType] WHERE [Name] ='Rule Dimension')
if @referenceTypeIdDimension > 0 update [ReferenceItemType] set [Name] = 'Rule Dimension #2' where ID = @referenceTypeIdDimension
INSERT INTO [dbo].[ReferenceItemType] ([Name],[DisplayFormat],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy]) VALUES ('Rule Dimension', '{Name}', GETDATE(), 0)
--popuplate Rule status reference list set @referenceTypeIdDimension = (SELECT ID FROM [ReferenceItemType] WHERE [Name] ='Rule Dimension') INSERT INTO [dbo].[ReferenceItem] ([ReferenceItemTypeID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[Code],[Visible]) VALUES (@referenceTypeIdDimension,GETDATE(),0,'Accuracy',1), (@referenceTypeIdDimension,GETDATE(),0,'Completeness',1), (@referenceTypeIdDimension,GETDATE(),0,'Conformity',1), (@referenceTypeIdDimension,GETDATE(),0,'Consistency',1), (@referenceTypeIdDimension,GETDATE(),0,'Duplication',1), (@referenceTypeIdDimension,GETDATE(),0,'Integrity',1)
GO

changeSet.author: Tomislav Duric
changeSet.sql:
--migrate rule data
declare @tempRuleTable table (ID int, RuleTypeId int, RuleDimensionId int, Status int)
insert into @tempRuleTable (ID, RuleTypeId, RuleDimensionId, Status) SELECT ID, RuleTypeId, RuleDimensionId, Status FROM [Rule]
declare @ruleCount int = (select count(*) from @tempRuleTable) declare @cnt int = 0;
declare @statusReferenceListTypeId int = (select ID from [ReferenceItemType] where Name = 'Rule Status') declare @dimensionReferenceListTypeId int = (select ID from [ReferenceItemType] where Name = 'Rule Dimension')
while @cnt < @ruleCount begin declare @ruleId int = (select ID from @tempRuleTable order by ID offset @cnt rows fetch next 1 rows only) declare @ruleTypeId int = (select RuleTypeId from @tempRuleTable order by ID offset @cnt rows fetch next 1 rows only) declare @ruleDimension int = (select RuleDimensionId from @tempRuleTable order by ID offset @cnt rows fetch next 1 rows only) declare @ruleStatus int = (select Status from @tempRuleTable order by ID offset @cnt rows fetch next 1 rows only) declare @fieldValue int declare @fieldTypeId int --create new field types for a rule if @ruleDimension is not null set @fieldTypeId = (select Id from [FieldType] where [LookupObjectType] = 'ReferenceItem' and [LookupObjectID] = @dimensionReferenceListTypeId and [Object] = 'RuleType' and [ObjectID] = @ruleTypeId)
IF @fieldTypeId IS NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO [FieldType] ([Name],[FriendlyName],[Type],[LookupObjectType],[LookupObjectID],[LookupDisplayFormat],[Object],[ObjectID],[IsRequired],[IsListable],[IsDisplayable],[IsEditable],[AllowAllValue],[IsPartOfKey],[AllowMultipleValues],[ShowIfEmpty]) VALUES ('Dimension','Dimension','Lookup','ReferenceItem',@dimensionReferenceListTypeId,'{Code}','RuleType',@ruleTypeId,0,1,1,1,0,0,0,0) set @fieldTypeId = (select Id from [FieldType] where [LookupObjectType] = 'ReferenceItem' and [LookupObjectID] = @dimensionReferenceListTypeId and [Object] = 'RuleType' and [ObjectID] = @ruleTypeId) END set @fieldValue = (select RI.ID from [ReferenceItem] RI inner join [RuleDimension] RD on RD.Name = RI.Code where ReferenceItemTypeID = @dimensionReferenceListTypeId and RD.ID = @ruleDimension)
INSERT INTO [dbo].[Field] ([ObjectType],[ObjectID],[FieldTypeID],[Value],[UpdatedBy],[UpdatedOn]) VALUES ('Rule',@ruleId,@fieldTypeId,@fieldValue,0,GETDATE())
if @ruleStatus is not null set @fieldTypeId = (select Id from [FieldType] where [LookupObjectType] = 'ReferenceItem' and [LookupObjectID] = @statusReferenceListTypeId and [Object] = 'RuleType' and [ObjectID] = @ruleTypeId)
IF @fieldTypeId IS NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO [FieldType] ([Name],[FriendlyName],[Type],[LookupObjectType],[LookupObjectID],[LookupDisplayFormat],[Object],[ObjectID],[IsRequired],[IsListable],[IsDisplayable],[IsEditable],[AllowAllValue],[IsPartOfKey],[AllowMultipleValues],[ShowIfEmpty]) VALUES ('Status','Status','Lookup','ReferenceItem',@statusReferenceListTypeId,'{Code}','RuleType',@ruleTypeId,1,0,1,1,0,0,0,0)
set @fieldTypeId = (select Id from [FieldType] where [LookupObjectType] = 'ReferenceItem' and [LookupObjectID] = @statusReferenceListTypeId and [Object] = 'RuleType' and [ObjectID] = @ruleTypeId) END
declare @fieldTextValue varchar(50) if @ruleStatus = 1 set @fieldTextValue = 'Draft' if @ruleStatus = 2 set @fieldTextValue = 'Active' if @ruleStatus = 3 set @fieldTextValue = 'Inactive'
set @fieldValue = (select ID from [ReferenceItem] where ReferenceItemTypeId = @statusReferenceListTypeId and Code = @fieldTextValue) INSERT INTO [dbo].[Field] ([ObjectType],[ObjectID],[FieldTypeID],[Value],[UpdatedBy],[UpdatedOn]) VALUES ('Rule',@ruleId,@fieldTypeId,@fieldValue,0,GETDATE())
set @cnt = @cnt + 1; end
